title: Strict chain model data for union comparison arrows
statement: For the comparison arrows on U ⊔ V, U, V and U ⊓ V, there are strict chain maps t,t',α,β with t≫β=α≫t' and derived-category isomorphisms from A,B,Cone(t),A',B',Cone(t') to the six displayed vertices.

source.place: Tags 08HZ, 08HY and 0DJ9, chain-level K-injective restriction construction

proof.text: Choose K-injective resolutions with injective terms, form the degreewise restriction sequence on the compact-open union and its two members, and lift the coefficient morphism functorially. The resulting strict square and functorial cone comparisons give the six displayed isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Chain-level decomposition of the union SES presentation.
